overview: The public website for Ovanite, a software company building thoughtful digital products, with a CMS-driven product showcase and contact and waitlist forms.
features: Home page with hero, philosophy, products in development, approach, about, FAQs and closing CTA
Products page that automatically shows products published from the admin CMS
About, Contact, Waitlist, Thank You, Privacy, Terms and a custom 404 page
Contact and waitlist forms with validation, loading, success and error states
Duplicate submission protection with an already received message
Responsive navigation, breadcrumbs and a consistent footer on every page
Admin CMS for products, FAQs, site copy, submissions and team
